revised_prompts:
Template: webtoon-shot-v1. Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, 1536x2048 px, with 5% safe margin. Medium_full shot, over_shoulder angle, normal lens feel, subtle push-in. Camera is just inside the doorway area of the dining hall, looking past Bram’s back toward the hallway, with focus on Bram opening the door and a bowed anonymous messenger silhouette at the far end of the dark corridor. Keep the lower outside-door area clear for dialogue overlay; the messenger’s face must be unreadable in every way.

Scene: the instant urgent news enters a family meal. Warm dining hall light meets cold bluish-gray corridor light at the threshold. Mood tense, restrained, not heroic.

Use the medieval dining hall space from the reference as the environment: timber interior, dining table and chairs, hearth glow, eastern door open, corridor beyond dark and cool-toned. Perspective layers: foreground Bram’s shoulder/back, midground doorframe and Kyle, background dark corridor with indistinct messenger silhouette.

Character 1: Bram Waldhart in foreground left, about 22% from left, 20% from top, occupying about 32% width and 66% height. Preserve identity cues from reference only: broad middle-aged shoulders, short beard outline, forest-green doublet without cape. Pose: back and slight half-profile at the open door. Expression: only a hardened jawline visible. Gaze angled downward outside the door. Action: opening the door and listening to urgent report.

Character 2: Kyle Waldhart in midground right, about 66% from left, 42% from top, occupying about 17% width and 36% height. Preserve identity cues from reference only: 14-year-old boy build, reddish-brown hair, plain blue jerkin with no crest. Pose: half-risen from chair, turning sharply toward the door. Expression: immediate alertness. Gaze toward outside door. Action: pushing up from chair, one hand moving toward his waist.

Messenger: outside the door / down the corridor, only a hurried bowed silhouette, no readable face, no distinct costume design, no defining features.

Composition: open door centered, Bram’s shoulder prominent in foreground, Kyle partially framed by table/chair, corridor receding behind threshold. Screen direction right-to-left. State continuity: the first knock has just ended; now the door is open and the information that the river water level is rising abnormally has just been delivered, but show this only through staging, not text.

Visual treatment: clean 2D webtoon rendering, crisp line emphasis on Bram’s tense shoulders and Kyle’s reaction, low-contrast cool corridor against warm room, painterly-soft but anime-influenced medieval fantasy style matching provided references. Leave visually quiet negative space at upper-right region roughly left 51%, top 3%, width 41%, height 26%. No speech balloons, no captions, no readable text, no watermark, no signature, no duplicate characters, no finalized messenger character design.
